title: WfGg Radar operational discovery and controlled runtime evolution
problem: Prevent Autopilot PARTIAL_RETRY_LIMIT from stopping the entire production run when one seed repeatedly yields partial cycles, while preserving valid 9/9 evidence and all existing safety guards.
goals: Treat repeated partial cycles as a seed-local exhaustion condition rather than a global Autopilot failure.
After the configured partial retry budget is exhausted, mark the current seed SEED_SKIPPED_PARTIAL / PARTIAL_AFTER_RETRIES.
Preserve any already-valid 9/9 cycle evidence in Collector history while not counting the skipped seed as a confirmed cluster.
Clear only the current in-memory seed state and continue automatically through Seed Scout to the next seed.
Preserve V6.19.9 targeted historical quality lookup.
Preserve V6.19.8 Collector cycle terminalization and V6.19.7 stale recovery.
Keep AUTH / NETWORK / CONNECTOR / SYSTEM and genuine global failures blocking.
non_goals: Do not count partial cycles as complete 9/9 evidence.
Do not confirm a cluster that has fewer than the required full cycles.
Do not modify historical Collector evidence while skipping a seed.
Do not weaken global AUTH / NETWORK / CONNECTOR / SYSTEM failure guards.
Do not change V6.19.9 targeted-history semantics.
Do not execute a Last War scan during the guard-only pilot probe.

current_change.purpose: Convert partial retry exhaustion from a global Autopilot failure into a seed-local skip-and-continue transition.

acceptance_criteria: The connector reports Autopilot version v6.19.10.
PARTIAL_RETRY_LIMIT no longer directly calls autopilotFail for the entire job.
A seed that reaches the partial retry limit is recorded with reason PARTIAL_AFTER_RETRIES and phase SEED_SKIPPED_PARTIAL.
Valid full-cycle IDs already observed for that seed remain preserved in Collector history and are not reclassified as partial evidence.
The skipped seed is not counted as a confirmed cluster.
Autopilot clears the current seed state and continues through Seed Scout.
V6.19.8 terminalization, V6.19.7 stale recovery and V6.19.6 no-data continuation remain present.
AUTH / NETWORK / CONNECTOR / SYSTEM and other genuine global failures remain blocking.
Pilot installation is SHA-pinned, rollback-capable and guard-probed without a Last War scan or Collector mutation.
Production promotion requires a separate explicit human approval.
architecture_invariants: GitHub stores code, branches, CI and release artifacts.
ChaCha DEV on ChaChaVPS is the runtime orchestrator.
ChaChaNas remains authoritative persistent storage for project data and backups.
VPS is runtime-oriented and not the authoritative durable project store.
Producer and verifier responsibilities remain separated.
